spells.name: Revive
spells.description: Brings target back to life, restores 10% of their health. Eliminates the experience penalty and con loss they would have suffered were they to have /release.

spells.name: Raise Fallen
spells.description: Brings target back to life, restores 30% of their health and 10% of their power. Eliminates the experience penalty and con loss they would have suffered were they to have /release.

spells.name: Reincarnate
spells.description: Brings target back to life, restores a portion of their health and power and eliminates the experience penalty and con loss they would have suffered were they to have /release.

spells.name: Resurrection
spells.description: Brings target back to life, restores 100% of their health and 50% of their power. Eliminates the experience penalty and con loss they would have suffered were they to have /release.
